title: Company cash, delivery pay and primary industry growth (vehicle prices live in vehicles.json)

startingCash.description: Company cash granted to a new world.

deliveryPay.description: A delivery pays price x units x (startPercent + percentPerTile x distance), the distance being the Manhattan tiles between the station where the load started and the delivery station.

startPercent.description: Percent of the price every delivery earns before any tile is counted, with at most two decimals. Keep it below percentPerTile x capacity x speed of every vehicle, so a vehicle on a longer route always earns more per year.

percentPerTile.description: Percent of the price added for each tile, with at most two decimals.

minimumDistance.description: Shortest distance paid for, also used when the load origin is unknown.

industryGrowth.description: Primary industries that deliver at least servedPercent of their monthly production for monthsToGrow months in a row gain a tier, up to maxLevel (zero-based, shown to the player from 1); each tier multiplies the output and the stock capacity by levelMultiplier.
